citations.claim: First violating step 1 still has energy recorded, showing simulation reached this step with controller force 46.38 exceeding limit 40

counterfactual.change: Raised force_limit from 40 to 80 with all else identical; controller force ~46.38 is then within limit so no violation

explanation: State-feedback gains adapted to heavy plant (cart 2kg, pole 0.2kg, L=1m) command ~46.38 N at step 1 from initial offset (x=0,v=0.5,theta=0.1,omega=0.3, dt=0.02), exceeding scenario force_limit 40. Force is applied unclipped, violating controller_force_limit before any push acts.
vision_note: The cart stays near the center of the track and the pole remains nearly upright from steps 0 to 4 with no fall or track exit. No dramatic motion or red violating body is visible; the system looks normally controlled.
